purpose: Check whether the Liaocheng municipal government PDF itself names the registration center or city-specific registration service, independently of secondary reporting.
assessment: The primary Liaocheng government PDF is a city-government-office notice issuing an implementation plan for digital government-service redesign. Search-indexed text from the PDF explicitly includes integrated taxes/fees for real-estate registration (“不动产登记‘税费统缴’”) as a city service-process work item. The PDF does not name 聊城市不动产登记中心 or assign that work to the center in the inspected/search-indexed material. Direct web open timed out and direct curl could not resolve the host, so a complete PDF text review was unavailable. The 2026-08-31 story previously cited by the draft is hosted by 10jqka, not an official government domain; it attributes a story to the Liaocheng Natural Resources and Planning Bureau and refers to the city registration center, but remains secondary attribution. Thus the government PDF confirms a local registration service context but not the local custodian institution; keep strict registry custody unresolved pending a first-party source that names the center.
registryBasis: Official city notice confirms a municipal digital-service work item for real-estate-registration tax/fee integration, but does not name the local registration center or identify the responsible agency. The article naming the center is carried by 10jqka and is not first-party. Strict local custodian status remains unresolved.

officialPrimarySources.observation: First-party Liaocheng Municipal People’s Government Office notice, title: implementation plan for digital workflow redesign to support “efficient completion of one matter.” Search-indexed document text includes real-estate-registration tax/fee integrated payment. It does not name the Liaocheng Real Estate Registration Center or assign it custody. Full direct fetch was unavailable (web open timeout; curl DNS failure).

Non-government 10jqka-hosted item, text credits Liaocheng Natural Resources and Planning Bureau as the source and describes a bureau leader’s visit to the city real-estate registration center. This is secondary attribution, not a primary municipal publication; it cannot independently establish the center’s formal local custody.
